articles.summary: Metriport launches Realtime Patient Notifications to enable active monitoring for patient admissions, discharges, and transfers (ADTs) across the US.
articles.title: Introducing: Realtime Patient Notifications

articles.summary: Metriport introduces Global Search capabilities across patient Medical Record Summaries, enabling providers to interact with their patients' clinical histories to surface relevant data in real-time.
articles.title: Introducing: Global Search

articles.summary: Metriport introduces Condition Chronicity Flagging feature to automatically sort patient conditions by chronic, non-chronic, and unspecified based on the ICD-10-CM codes.
articles.title: Introducing: Condition Chronicity Flagging

articles.summary: Metriport introduces direct enhanced pharmaceuticals data to proactively monitor patient prescriptions, refills, and more.
articles.title: Introducing: Pharmaceutical Intelligence
